notes: Lymph card now correct: no central pump; intrinsic vessel-wall contraction + skeletal muscle pump + respiratory pump.

Summary adds minor facts not on cards/points: 'closed loop' and 'Joints are the meeting points where bones move against each other'. Both are correct and trivial; consider trimming for strict 3-1 compliance.
Summary 'Veins have one-way valves' is slightly broader than the card ('many have valves'); acceptable, could say 'Many veins have one-way valves'.
Remodeling card now says 'many months, sometimes a year or more', matching the summary; duration is correct (remodeling commonly runs up to 1-2 years).
Four tissue types, five signs of inflammation, repair/proliferation (collagen, new small vessels) correct.
'Deep work is avoided over freshly inflamed tissue' is covered by the Inflammation card tip.
Carried-over note: 'The exam treats these as traditional ideas ...' is an unverifiable claim about the exam; suggest 'These are traditional ideas to recognize, not proven anatomy.'
Muscle actions correct: hamstrings flex knee/extend hip; quadriceps extend knee, rectus femoris also flexes hip; SITS correct; biceps flex / triceps extend elbow.
Summary mentions 'stabilizers' as a separate role; the Synergist card covers steadying a joint, so this is a near match. Optional: add 'stabilizer' to a card.

Classification now framed as structural ('grouped by what holds them together, which roughly matches how much they move'); fibrous (sutures), cartilaginous (intervertebral), synovial (knee, shoulder) correct and now on a point.
Rotation and circumduction now on a point; definitions correct.

Style: summary opens 'Movement words come in opposite pairs' then lists rotation and circumduction, which are not opposites of each other. Optional: 'Two other movements are rotation ... and circumduction ...'.
'which is one idea behind some stretching methods' (GTO / autogenic inhibition) is a small summary-only addition; correct and harmless.
Muscle spindle, Golgi tendon organ, anatomical position all correct.

DVT handling (stop and refer, do not massage) correct. Summary 'send it to the lungs' (pulmonary embolism) is a small addition beyond the card's 'could move the clot'; correct, optional to add to card.
Absolute vs local examples (fever, contagious illness; bruise, rash, open wound, varicose vein) correct. 'Absolute or general' treated as synonyms is common in massage texts.
Kidney area, avoiding long periods supine later in pregnancy (supine hypotension), and stop-and-refer for sudden swelling or pain now all appear on points; all correct.
Endangerment sites (anterior/lateral neck, axilla, inner elbow, popliteal fossa, kidney area) correct; popliteal artery/vein/tibial nerve correct.
Minor summary-only detail: older adults 'slower circulation' (card says 'medical conditions'). Correct and low-stakes; optional to add to the Older adult card.
Disabilities/chronic illness/trauma sentence covered by point 'Ask each client what works for them'.
Gate control theory correctly simplified (fast touch/pressure fibers inhibit slower pain signals at the spinal cord).
'This is why a relaxing session can leave a client feeling sleepy' is a small summary-only addition; harmless.
New card 'Deep tissue, trigger point, myofascial' matches the summary paragraph word for word; content correct (slow firm pressure; tender spots that refer pain; slow sustained stretch of fascia).
Five Swedish strokes, effleurage toward the heart and at start/end, cross-fiber friction, tapotement as stimulating, heat vs cold and compare table all correct.
Minor summary-only details: vibration described as 'shaking or trembling' and friction 'along' fibers have no card; correct and harmless.
SOAP, subjective vs objective, AROM (contractile + joint) vs PROM (mainly inert tissues/joint) correct.
Summary 'gently feel the tissue' (palpation) is a small addition; harmless.
Informed consent (before treatment, when the plan changes, can be withdrawn at any time), measurable goals, reassessment, and referral all correct and consistent with cards/points.
Transference/countertransference, power differential, dual relationship, and 'sexual contact never acceptable' correct.
Summary lists boundary types 'physical, emotional, social, and financial'; card lists touch, conversation, time, money, personal contact. Close enough.

Draping now correct in summary and card: genitals always covered; breasts covered for women, with a few states (e.g., TX, OR, WA) allowing breast work only with written consent; framed as varying with 'Check your state board'. Gluteal-cleft rule omitted; acceptable simplification.
Confidentiality tip fixed ('Private by default: share only with written permission or when the law requires'); exceptions framed as varying by state and by HIPAA status.
HIPAA card correct (covered providers and plans; applies e.g. when billing insurance electronically; clearinghouses omitted, acceptable). Source present.
Minor summary-only wording: 'the exam focuses on general ideas rather than exact numbers' (unverifiable claim about the exam) and 'Records should be stored securely'. Harmless; optional trim.
Standard Precautions now match CDC wording: blood, body fluids, secretions, excretions except sweat, nonintact skin, mucous membranes. Source present.
Handwashing 20 seconds matches CDC. Source present.
Minor summary-only additions: 'cover any cuts on your own hands', 'single most important habit', 'Table height should fit the therapist'. All correct; optional to add to cards.
Record retention correctly framed as varying ('check your state board'); summary adds 'and tax rules', which is harmless.
Medical terms (-itis, hyper-, hypo-) correct.
